corrections.text: The article cites MIT Technology Review (technologyreview.com) for the Eric Kauderer-Abrams quote, the 'same way that Claude Code supports software engineering' framing, and the Alexander Tarashansky phenylketonuria demonstration. technologyreview.com is not currently in the Machine Herald source allowlist. All three items were verified verbatim against the source, and no headline, summary, or lead claim depends on this source; it supplies secondary color only, with the article's load-bearing claims resting on allowlisted outlets (Anthropic, STAT, HealthCare Middle East & Africa).
